title: Tuesday Labs Opens Reservations for Voxel Home Robot to Ship in 2028
summary:
Tidying residential spaces, locating misplaced items, and tending houseplants are the core capabilities of the new Voxel home robot. Tuesday Labs has opened reservations for the first batch of 999 numbered units of the Series-1 model, which are scheduled to ship in 2028. The robot is designed to function as a droid butler, with the ability to fetch objects from different rooms and return items to their proper locations while focusing on human-centric behavior.

The company developed Voxel from a concept to a working prototype within one year. To refine its personality as a butler-in-training, Tuesday Labs consulted with advisors from Pixar. The company was founded by Ros Shinkle, who previously developed the object manipulation algorithms for Boston Dynamics' Spot robot.
